teacherNotes.title: 5-Step Progression

teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack, eat, drink, bread, soup, salad, meat, coffee, tea

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack, eat, drink, bread, soup, salad, meat, coffee, tea
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• For breakfast I eat toast and drink coffee (stating morning meal)
• What time do you have lunch? (asking mealtime)
• I usually eat salad for lunch (stating habitual meal)
• Dinner is at seven o'clock (stating evening mealtime)
Pronunciation Focus:
Pronunciation of 'bread' /bred/ and 'soup' /suːp/.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Verbs 'eat' and 'drink' + Present Simple Habitual ('I have breakfast at 8', 'She drinks coffee')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Verbs 'eat' and 'drink' + Present Simple Habitual ('I have breakfast at 8', 'She drinks coffee')
Controlled Practice:
Morning meal after waking up. What is it called?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: What do you usually eat for breakfast?
B: I eat eggs and bread, and I drink orange juice.
A: What time do you have dinner?
B: I have dinner at eight o'clock in the evening with my family.
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to three people describing their daily meal times and favorite food.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: I can describe my daily meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner) and express what I like to eat and drink.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice speaking with your partner: I can describe my daily meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner) and express what I like to eat and drink.
Writing Task:
Write 3-5 sentences in your notebook applying target phrases from today's lesson.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60m Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up & Goal; 10-25m Vocab & Chunks; 25-40m Grammar Practice; 40-55m Speaking Pair Task; 55-60m Cool-down.
• 90m Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m 5-step Vocab Drills; 30-50m Grammar Workshop; 50-70m Roleplay; 70-85m Writing; 85-90m Wrap-up.
• 120m Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Vocab Lab; 40-70m Grammar Simulation; 70-100m Group Activity; 100-115m Writing Portfolio; 115-120m Reflection.
